company.shortDescription: Fly is a decentralized cross-chain liquidity aggregation protocol for crypto asset swaps.
company.description: Fly is a decentralized liquidity aggregation protocol for cross-chain swaps of crypto assets. The platform aggregates liquidity across multiple blockchains and DEXs to execute fast, cost-effective trades without users interacting with bridges directly. Users connect non-custodial wallets, view portfolio balances across supported chains, and swap a wide variety of tokens, including LP and yield tokens. Fly offers features such as advanced routing, insurance for cross-chain swaps, and a loyalty program with NFT-based rewards. The native FLY token is used for governance, staking, and distributing platform fees to stakers, liquidity providers, and the community.
